title: OptST: Optimizing Semantic Tokenization for LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semantic information can enrich the identifiers and structured fields used by recommender systems. Semantic tokenization provides a structured representation of this information by converting LLM-derived user profiles into discrete tokens. In the common two-stage pipeline, the tokenizer is trained before the recommender. Its token assignments are then treated as fixed input features during recommendation training. As a result, the downstream recommender can learn how to use the assigned indices, but it cannot revise the semantic partition that produced them. Making this partition task-aware is difficult because nearest-code assignment is discrete, and unconstrained adaptation may also distort the geometry learned during pretraining. Moreover, a fixed token depth exposes the same semantic resolution to every interaction. translated_title: OptST：面向大语言模型增强推荐的语义分词优化
translated_abstract: 语义信息可以丰富推荐系统所使用的标识符和结构化字段。语义分词通过将大语言模型导出的用户画像转换为离散token，为这些信息提供了结构化表示。在常见的两阶段流程中，分词器先于推荐器进行训练，其token分配结果在推荐训练阶段被当作固定的输入特征。这样一来，下游推荐器虽然能够学习如何使用分配到的索引，却无法修改产生这些索引的语义划分。要让这种划分具备任务感知能力十分困难，因为最近邻码本分配是离散的，而且不受约束的自适应调整还可能破坏预训练阶段学到的几何结构。此外，固定的token深度使得每一次交互都只能获得相同的语义分辨率。为此，我们提出了OptST（优化语义分词），使预训练好的分词器能够响应下游推荐任务的需求……
tldr: 提出OptST方法，让预训练的语义分词器能够感知并适配下游推荐任务，突破传统两阶段流程中token语义划分固定、分辨率单一的限制。
en_tdlr: OptST makes a pretrained semantic tokenizer responsive to the downstream recommendation task, overcoming the fixed semantic partitions and uniform token resolution of conventional two-stage LLM-enhanced recommendation pipelines.
